data.one_liner: Hijri (Umm al-Qura) date picker for Flutter using built-in date picker UI.
data.what_it_does: Provides a CalendarDelegate for Flutter's built-in date picker UI to select Hijri (Islamic) dates. It supports Flutter's standard showDatePicker, CalendarDatePicker, YearPicker, and InputDatePickerFormField using HijriDateTime values.
use_when: You need a Hijri (Umm al-Qura) date picker integrated into standard Material 3 date picker components.
You want to use Flutter's native date picker UI, dialogs, and text input forms with Islamic calendar dates.
avoid_when: You are using a Flutter version older than 3.32.0.
You require custom day/weekday widget builders, which were removed in version 5.0.0.
strengths: Leverages Flutter's built-in date picker UI and CalendarDelegate API.
Full Material 3 theming support via DatePickerThemeData.
Supports both calendar and text-input entry modes.
weaknesses: Custom day/weekday builders are not supported in v5.0.0.
data.setup_notes: Register standard material localization delegates in MaterialApp.
